title: Listings
description: List your units on the /rent pages for free. People who are interested reach you on LINE.

empty.title: No listings yet
empty.description: Pick a unit from your portfolio, add the photos the platform asks for and publish.

reasons.label: Why it is reviewed
reasons.first_listing: First listing of an owner who is not verified yet
reasons.price_outlier: Rent far from the area's median
reasons.flagged_words: Wording our team needs to look at

create.title: New listing
create.description: Start from a unit in your portfolio; its size, rooms and address come along.
create.unitHint: A unit with a live listing can be picked, but cannot be published twice.
create.headline: Headline
create.headlineHint: Short and to the point, e.g. 1-bedroom condo near BTS Ari

editor.closeBody: It disappears from the /rent pages and cannot be reopened. To list again, create a new listing.

state.draft: Nobody sees this listing yet. Check the photos and details, then publish.
state.pending_review: Our team is reviewing it, usually within one working day. You can still edit.
state.published: Your listing is live on the /rent pages.
state.paused: Paused: nobody sees it until you resume.
state.rejected: The listing did not pass review. Fix it as explained and publish again.

editor.hiddenBody: Viewers reported this listing. Our team will look into it and let you know; until then it is not public.

missing.areaSqm: Unit size (edit the unit in your portfolio)
missing.bedrooms: Bedrooms (edit the unit in your portfolio)
missing.bathrooms: Bathrooms (edit the unit in your portfolio)
missing.address: Unit address (edit the unit in your portfolio)

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: The first photo is the cover. Location data (GPS) is removed from every photo automatically.
photos.caption: Caption (optional)
photos.empty: No photos yet. Add at least five bright, sharp photos of the unit.

details.title: Details and terms
details.description: Everything a renter wants to know before a viewing.
details.facilitiesHint: Tap to add, or type your own and press Enter
details.showUnitNo: Show the unit number in the address
details.showUnitNoHint: The building's address is always public (honest listings); the unit number is your choice.

availability.title: Viewing times
availability.description: When you can show the unit. People book a viewing within these windows.
availability.empty: Not set. Add at least one window so people can book a viewing.

verification.title: Verified owner
verification.description: Listings of a verified unit get the "verified owner" badge and publish without waiting for review.
verification.verifiedBody: The verified-owner badge shows on every listing of this unit.
verification.pending: Evidence sent — our team is checking it
verification.filesHint: Photos or PDFs, up to 5. You may cover your ID number. Files are deleted after the review.
